title: feat(core, metadata-core, objectql): the package-scoped resolution rule as a lean core, engine functions by package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9P2U4PEuTduoYsNLV1n4W61)_

Fixes #31716
Part of #31527

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Narrowing: the save door's write scope for a residual owner (ADR-0130 D4, an id with no package record) is now its declared closure, where before it narrowed nothing. First-party residual owners whose writes it now refuses: 0. Measured over examples app-crm, app-multi-package, app-showcase and app-todo (config and dist), every `packages/**/objectstack.config.ts`, and the dogfood stacks (showcase boot; the composed stacks in multi-package-artifact, picklist-shared-across-objects, security-catalog-cold-boot-environment-holder and install-local-connector-package-ref). Each multi-package stack keeps a member's manifest, so its owner has a package record. HotCRM is outside this session's repository access and was not measured.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：把 ADR-0150「按软件包解析裸名」的规则搬进 `@objectstack/core`(纯函数，持有者集合和依赖闭包由调用方传入),闭包只在 `@objectstack/metadata-core` 走一遍；objectql 的 `resolvePackageScopedName` 变成这条规则的适配器，另加引擎函数的适配器，并修了四处：E5 发现的邮件模板语言追加被误算成第二个持有者、无包函数改按平台持有、`__runtime__` 调用方按无包处理、残余所有者（无包记录的栈）声明的依赖进入同一个闭包。
- 为什么改：E 系列卡要在 objectql 的精简入口、lint、保存门里读同一条规则和同一个闭包，原先规则在 objectql、闭包散在 lint 和 metadata-protocol,精简入口读不到；E5 实测依赖包追加的语言会让基础模板的无包发送被拒。
- 风险与回滚：还没有任何读者接这条规则；搬走的名字都在原包原名再导出。唯一的行为变化是保存门：以残余所有者的 id 写入时，现在按它声明的依赖闭包来判，之前不收窄。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。
- 先看:`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`(规则),`packages/metadata-core/src/package-closure.ts`(唯一的闭包),`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `packageScopedHoldersOf`(追加不算持有者)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run src/package-scoped-resolution.test.ts` 和 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-resolver.test.ts`,R 的 33 个原测试一字未改。
- 需要你做的：无。命名和落点由 epic 席位裁定。

## What changes

Epic #31527 child R2. The ADR-0150 D3 rule moves where every reader reaches it, the closure is walked in one place, and the engine's functions resolve in their referrer's package. ⛔ No reader is wired. ⛔ The closure is not widened (N1 waits on #31678).

- **`@objectstack/core`** — `package-scoped-resolution.ts` (new): `resolvePackageScopedHolders(query, source, closureOf)`, D3's three steps over a holder set and a closure the caller supplies, plus the refusal vocabulary (`PACKAGE_SCOPED_TYPES`, `ENGINE_FUNCTION_TYPE`, `PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES_BY_TYPE`, `OVERRIDABLE_BASELINE_PACKAGES`, `BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES`, the holder, refusal and resolution types). `packageScopedHolderSource(pairs)` builds a source from `(package, item)` pairs; a holder named twice is a `TypeError`.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-core`** — `package-closure.ts` (new): the one walk. `resolvePackageClosure` (from lint), `widenPairClosureToAppMembers` and `packageDependencyClosure` (from metadata-protocol), `packageResolutionClosure` and `KERNEL_NAMESPACE` (from objectql). It depends only on `@objectstack/spec`, is already in the lean entry's admitted set, and is already a dependency of every reader, so no package edge is added.
- **`@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`** — re-export the moved names under the same names. The save door's `resolveWritePackageScope` is unchanged.
- **`@objectstack/objectql`**
  - `resolvePackageScopedName` keeps its signature and answers. It is now the rule's call with the registry's holders and `packageResolutionClosure`.
  - `resolvePackageScopedFunction(engine, { name, callerPackageId })` (new) is the rule over `ObjectQL#functionHoldersOf(name)` (new). The engine keeps one entry per registering package (owner `app:PACKAGE_ID` read as the package id). An owner-less registration is the **platform's** item (epic seat ruling 6729484996): code a plugin or the host registers, in every caller's reach like a `sys` package (D2). A package caller holding none counts it beside its closure's holders, so one answers (step `platform`, holder kind `platform`) and two or more refuse `ambiguous-in-closure`, naming each. A caller with no package gets the environment's own item first, then counts the platform as one more holder beside the packages: the only one answers, and two or more refuse `ambiguous-in-environment`, naming each (re-review 6730444942). Core carries it as the optional `PackageScopedHolderSource#platformItem`. `unregisterFunctionsByPackage` removes the package's holder entry too, and its count is unchanged. `resolveFunction` / `resolveFunctionEntry` are untouched.
  - **`__runtime__` caller (ruled from E6):** `RUNTIME_COMPATIBILITY_PACKAGE_ID` (`'__runtime__'`, exported from `@objectstack/core`) is the package id `ObjectQL#registerObject` stamps when its caller gives none. The engine and the compatibility API now take it from that one spelling. The rule reads a caller carrying it as a caller with no package, next to the `sys_metadata` sentinel, so it no longer loses environment items to D3 (a). How an item stamped with it counts as a holder is unchanged.
  - **Residual owner closure (ruled from E6):** a residual owner (ADR-0130 D4, with no package record) declared dependencies the walk never read. The registry now keeps them in its own map (`recordResidualOwnerDependencies` / `residualOwnerDependenciesOf`), the manifest service records them when it registers a stack's residual (`plugin.ts`, next to `recordResidualOwner`), and `packageDependencyClosure` reads them through the optional `PackageClosureRegistry#residualOwnerDependenciesOf` whenever `getPackage` has no row. No package record appears and `getAllPackages` is unchanged. **Save door effect, declared:** a write stamped with a residual owner's id is now judged against that owner's declared closure. Before, it narrowed nothing, because the walk answered `undefined`.
  - **E5 item (#28802):** `SchemaRegistry#packageScopedHoldersOf` no longer counts a bundle **addition** as a holder. A package whose members of a bundled type's name are all members another holder in its declared dependency closure does not hold adds to that holder's bundle (a dependent's locale its base does not ship). So it is no second holder of the base's name for a bare read. The dependent's own bare read keeps its own holding (`packageScopedHoldersOf(type, name, callerPackageId)`), so step 1 answers its own item as on main (review item 1). `getPackageScopedItem` naming the dependent still reads the addition. A dependent holding a member its base holds, and a package that does not declare the holder, stay holders, and the bare read refuses them. Q1 on #31677 (a clash sealed before phase 1) is not touched.

## Tests

- `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.test.ts` (new, 21): every arm on the rule alone, the closure asked only when needed, red lines 1 and 2, the exceptions, the holder source, and the platform's item.
- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-resolver.test.ts`: R's 33 tests unchanged (0 deleted lines, docblock appended). New: 18 R2 tests (parity of the core rule plus the one walk with `resolvePackageScopedName` over every arm and caller, a bundled type per member, the holder source, `function`, the engine's function holders and their removal, identity pins that objectql re-exports core's rule and metadata-core's walk), 7 tests for the bundle addition (including the dependent's own step 1, both storage shapes), and 4 tests for the platform's function.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-write-package-scope.test.ts` (new): identity pins showing that the save door, metadata-protocol's barrel and lint read metadata-core's one walk. Together with the objectql identity pins, this pins that no second closure is computed.
- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.resolve-package-closure.test.ts`: one identity pin added.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/package-closure.test.ts` (new, 4): the residual owner's closure is walked transitively by both the save door's walk and the resolution closure, an unknown id still narrows nothing, a package record wins, and a registry without the member reads as before.
- `packages/objectql/src/manifest-service-residual-objects.test.ts`: one case added. A booted stack's residual owner declares a dependency, the registry records it, no package record appears, and `packageResolutionClosure` reaches it.
- Core and objectql each add `__runtime__` caller pins (an environment-only item is reached; an item stamped `__runtime__` is still a holder; the compatibility API stamps the one spelling), and objectql adds residual-closure pins (reaches a declared dependency, refused when declaring none, a package record wins).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read.dogfood.test.ts`: one case added. Over the booted showcase, after the dependent publishes `fr-FR`, a package-less resolve of the base's template answers the base (`en-US`), `fr-FR` on the base's address is not-found (as the HTTP read's 404), and the read naming the dependent reaches the addition.

**Forced test change:** `packages/objectql/src/federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` drops its READERS row `'package-scoped-resolver.ts#<module> :: queue'`. The type list that mentions `queue` moved to `@objectstack/core`, so that file no longer reads it.

## Acceptance notes

- Placement (scope amendment 6728590686, accepted by the epic seat): the rule is in core and the walk is in metadata-core. `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` and `core-boundary.ratchet` are green with the admitted set unchanged. `ADMITTED_PACKAGES` is not widened.
- Red lines: the rule never loosens, every refusal names every candidate, and every change is additive. Each was pinned and ablated, with readings below.
- Surface beyond the card's file: `engine.ts` / `engine-hooks-and-functions.ts` (the function holders), `engine-compatibility-api.ts` (the one `__runtime__` spelling), `plugin.ts` (the residual record, coordinated with E6's thread), `index.ts` barrels, `metadata-core`, `registry.ts` (the E5 item and the residual map), and the test files named above.

<details><summary>Ablation readings (each restored, blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`:

1. Core `pickUnique` with several holders returns the first: 3 failed / 14 passed (17).
2. Core step 3 falls to an environment-wide guess: 4 failed / 13 passed.
3. Core refusal drops the environment candidate: 2 failed / 15 passed.
4. Core outside-closure candidates `slice(0, 1)`: 1 failed / 16 passed.
5. `packageScopedHolderSource` duplicate-holder throw disabled: 1 failed / 16 passed.
6. Engine `holders.clear()` before set (one holder per name): 4 failed / 47 passed (51).
7. Registry adapter admits `function`: 1 failed / 50 passed.
8. Registry: member-disjointness check deleted: 1 failed (red line 1, a dependent holding the base's member).
9. Registry: the dependency check dropped (`if (base === packageId) continue;`): 1 failed (red line 1, a package not declaring the holder).
10. Dogfood leg (the dogfood reads dist): `packageScopedHoldersOf` returns every holder (`--hold`, objectql rebuilt, dogfood run, restored, rebuilt). The new case was red: `expected { status: 'refused', … } to deeply equal { status: 'resolved', … }`, 1 failed / 12 passed. After restore and rebuild, 13 passed. The ablated rebuild exited 1 at the declaration step (the unused helper), after the JS emit the dogfood reads, and the red reading shows the mutation reached it.
11. Review item 1 — the registry drops the caller's own addition again (`(id) => !this.isBundleAddition`): 2 failed (the dependent's own step 1, both storage shapes).
12. Review item 2 — the engine reads owner-less as the environment again (`environmentItem: () => platform`): 4 failed.
13. Review item 2 — core step 2 ignores the platform's item: 2 failed / 19 passed (21).
14. `__runtime__` — the core normalization deleted: 1 failed / 22 passed (23).
15. Residual — the walk ignores the residual record: 1 failed / 3 passed (4).
16. Residual — the registry records nothing: 2 failed (resolver pin, manifest-service pin).
17. Residual — the manifest service records nothing: 1 failed / 61 passed (62).
18. Re-review item 1 — a caller with no package lets the platform answer beside a package holder: 1 failed / 22 passed (23).


</details>

Head `c1c15367` (main merged; main's `engine.ts` change merged cleanly).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 81 derived, all exit 0. `--ran` reconcile: 81 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (exit 0).
- Under `os-verify-lock` at this head (VERDICT command-exit 0): full `turbo run build` of `./packages/**`; core typecheck and test, 138 files / 3174; objectql typecheck and test, 574 / 11744.
- Under the lock at `15d685cf` (only the core env-wide platform step changed since): metadata-core 27 / 1003; metadata-protocol 329 passed + 4 skipped / 22597; lint 197 / 8365; dogfood `email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read`, `analytics-label-scope` and `api-key-owner-revoke`, 3 files / 26; cli `serve-config-boot-residual.integration`, 14 / 14.
- Lint: the touched packages have no `lint` script. Root `eslint --no-inline-config` over the changed `.ts` files: exit 0.
- Line budget: +1945 / −582 over 23 files, under 3000.

</details>

## Review round 1 (6729484996), answered

- Item 1: the dependent's bare read of its own added member answers its own item at step 1 again, and its read of a member only the base ships is not-found, as on main. Both are pinned and the pins go red without the fix.
- Item 2: an owner-less function is the platform's, as ruled. It is pinned in core and over the engine, and the pins go red without the fix.
- Two items ruled from E6, both pinned red without the fix: the `__runtime__` caller, and the residual owner's declared closure (the save-door effect is declared above).
- Re-review 6730444942: for a caller with no package, the platform is one more holder beside the packages (pinned in core and over the engine, red without the fix). The residual narrowing is measured at 0 first-party (the `Narrowing:` line).
- N1 is ruled declared-closure-only (6729820123): no sibling widening, so the closure stays ADR-0141 plus `sys`. Q1 is ruled A (6729831159): no sealed-set arm.
- `Fixes #31716` plus `Part of #31527`. New public names accepted. In this round, also `platformItem`, holder kind `platform`, step `platform`, `RUNTIME_COMPATIBILITY_PACKAGE_ID`, `PackageClosureRegistry#residualOwnerDependenciesOf` and `SchemaRegistry#recordResidualOwnerDependencies` / `residualOwnerDependenciesOf`, which carry the rulings. Member-grain stays the later R amendment.
- E3 (core host) supplies its closure from `packageResolutionClosure`. The identity pins here hold the one walk.
